instruction: Dissolve the sugar in 500 ml of hot water; cool and bottle.
Ferment pineapple skins and cores with jaggery and cinnamon for 3 days.
Strain, fortify with feni and bottle.
Pound chillies and garlic to a coarse thecha; dry with the salt at low heat.
Coarse-grind the beans; steep in cold water for 16 hours; strain.
Macerate melon with sugar overnight; strain and add toddy vinegar.
Steep hibiscus in hot water; strain and dissolve the sugar.
Soak the chillies in the vinegar for 2 hours.
Grind everything to a smooth, thick paste; jar and refrigerate.
Roast grated coconut and onions until deep brown.
Roast the spices; grind everything with water to a paste.
Sweat onions in coconut oil; add tomatoes and the ground chilli and turmeric.
Add coconut milk and kokum; simmer without boiling.
